newsitem.title: USA: Video Lottery hires financial adviser.
newsitem.headline: Video Lottery hires financial adviser.

text.p: Video Lottery Technnologies Inc said Wednesday it hired investment banking firm Raymond James & Associates Inc to advise the company on "certain strategic alternatives."
The company made the announcement a day after one of its shareholder, investor William Spier, withdrew his offer to buy the company at $6 a share.
Spier said he decided to withdraw his bid because the company's board of directors had repeatedly refused to consider it seriously.
Spier is a director of the company and leader of a group of investors that owns 14.4 percent of Video.
Video, which expressed its disappointment in Spier's move, said it had asked him to review "certain issues" regarding his offer, such as regulatory approval.
The company provides terminals, software and services to the video lottery market.
